quote:
120 days before December 31, 2026 is **September 2, 2026**. The SPA is dated **September 21, 2026**. The extension deadline passed 19 days before the SPA was signed.

The option is now irrevocably lost. Unless Vantrell agrees to a new arrangement, the Supply Agreement expires on December 31, 2026
reason: The memo cites Supply Agreement §3.2 and the 120-day notice requirement measured from the December 31, 2026 end of the Initial Term under §3.1. It calculates the deadline correctly as September 2, 2026 and notes this was before the September 21, 2026 SPA signing. It concludes the extension right, including the extension pricing, is lost and that this affects valuation. That matches the ledger entry in substance.
